_readme: Source of truth for the four voice clips (M2-M5). Text comes from the Week 2 content pack. All voices are fully synthetic (Kokoro neural TTS); none is a clone of a real person. Edit the text or voices here, then run: python scripts/audio/generate_audio.py

segments.speaker: Emily (young woman, crying, rushed)
segments.text: Grandpa? Grandpa, it's me, it's Emily. Please, I'm in really big trouble, they won't let me go...

segments.speaker: Caller (man, calm and firm)
segments.text: Listen carefully. We have your granddaughter. She is not hurt. You will send five thousand dollars today. Do not call the police. I will call back in ten minutes. Have the money ready.

segments.speaker: Caller (man, polite, slightly robotic)
segments.text: Hello, this is Daniel from the Windows Technical Department. Our servers show your computer is sending error messages and has a dangerous virus. If it is not fixed today, your files and banking information may be lost. Please call us back right away at 1-888-555-0132 so a technician can connect to your computer. Again, 1-888-555-0132.

segments.speaker: Grandson (young man, upset, a little muffled)
segments.text: Hi Grandma, it's me... I'm so sorry. I got pulled over and they found something in my friend's car, and now I'm under arrest. I'm okay, but I need bail money today. My lawyer, Mr. Harris, is going to call you. Please do what he says. And please don't tell Mom. I love you.

clips.title: Call recording: 'I was in a car accident'

segments.speaker: Grandson (same voice as M4, shaken, a little muffled)
segments.text: Grandpa? It's me. I was in a car accident. I'm okay, I just cut my lip, so I sound weird. The other driver got hurt and the police say I have to pay for the damage or I go to jail. A lawyer, Mr. Cole, is going to call you. Please don't tell Dad. I'm really scared.
